name: SFTP Storage Share
author: red_thirten@yahoo.com
description:
A simple "empty" egg that acts as a private SFTP storage share by utilizing Pelican's built in SFTP
system for servers. Sub-users can be added to the server by the owner to allow additional people to
access the share. "Starting" the server performs no actions and it should be left off.

startup.label: Default
startup.command:
echo -e "

\033[0;31mThere is no need to start this server. The SFTP service is always running. Feel free to stop the server now.
\t\033[0;36m(Sub-users can be added via the Users tab to add/remove access to the share in real time)

"

install.script: # Pelican SFTP Storage Share Egg ~ David Wolfe (Red-Thirten) ~ 2023-01-27
